|translation='''Title:''' Anakin's Lightsaber

'''Card text:''' Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability &gt; 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny &gt; ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printing states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences.
